thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: gcp-southeast4 - GPU pool exhausted, autoscaler stalled. Queue growth detected for prod-generation (latency spike, 503s increasing). Pager: @Alice (oncall) @Eve (SRE)

Alice (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing 95%+ queue length on the frontdoor. Any automated failovers?

Eve (SRE): Confirming autoscaler attempted 3 scaleups and hit quota/limits. Metrics show 'quotaExceeded' from GCP for GPUs in region.

Ben - infra: Copy. Checking allocation logs now. `kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-0 --since=10m` shows repeated failures: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z autoscaler: Requesting 8 GPUs
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z gcp: quotaExceeded: quota 'GPUS_STANDARD' for region southeast4
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z autoscaler: backing off and requeue
```

Carol (prodeng): Customer impact: some requests are timing out at 10s, others get 429 from gateway. Which products are affected? Looks like realtime-chat and long-runner batch jobs. Chat SLA at risk.

Alice (oncall): Emergency mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical endpoints (batch rerank, background indexing) 2) route latency-sensitive traffic to eu-west1 fallback pool 3) enable CPU fallback for small models if possible. Starting 1 and 2 now.

Ben - infra: Throttling rule pushed: `route: /batch/* -> 10% capacity` and `route: /rerank -> 5%` (applied). Pushing fallback routing to eu-west1 for chat+: `traffic-route set --service chat --fallback eu-west1`

Dan - support: Notifying affected enterprise customers with a short note. Drafted message and sending now.

Alice (oncall): On the autoscaler side, we can't increase GPU quota from our side. I opened a GCP support ticket (see below). In parallel, can we spin up smaller cached workers to clear queue?

Eve (SRE): Starting a lightweight CPU-backed tier for safe decodes for small-context requests. Will adjust model selector to prefer quantized 4-bit variants on CPU where acceptable. Deploy command: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod apply -f cpu-fallback-deployment.yaml --record
```

Ben - infra: CPU fallback coming up. But queue backlog is huge — predicted drain time ~ 25min at current concurrency. If the queue keeps growing, customer-facing latency will still degrade.

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2307. Severity: P1. Pager escalations scheduled every 5 minutes.

Carol (prodeng): Let's reduce max tokens and enable early stopping for the chat endpoint to lower per-request GPU time. Can we push a runtime flag?

Alice (oncall): Patch applied to routing config to set `max_tokens: 512` for realtime-chat and `stop_on_nonessential: true`. Also lowered default temperature to reduce decoding loops.

Ben - infra: We're seeing quota API responses: `projects/12345/regions/southeast4: Quota usage 100% (GPUS_STANDARD). Limit 160 -> requested 8 -> denied`. Our on-demand quota is fully consumed by other tenants in the project (unexpected burst).

Eve (SRE): Contacting GCP support now via console and chat. Sharing request_id: 4f7a1c. Asking for temporary quota bump or region failover permission.

GCP Support Bot: Support ticket created: TICKET-99217. Estimated initial response in 30-60 minutes. For urgent quota increases, please submit a quota change request in the GCP console.

Alice (oncall): While we wait on support, can we fail open to multi-region routing for high-priority keys? That will increase cost but keeps SLAs.

Ben - infra: Implemented canary cross-region routing for keys in 'enterprise-critical' allowlist. Traffic flowing to eu-west1 and us-west2 now. Monitoring for cross-region latency.

Dan - support: Sent customers the interim mitigation note: "We are rerouting critical traffic to alternate regions and enabling CPU fallbacks. Expect intermittent increases in latency; full service restoration pending cloud quota increase." Responses so far: 2 customers acknowledged, 1 asked for ETA.

Carol (prodeng): Any telemetry on error classes? Gateway 503 and 429 mainly, but also `model-unavailable` from runtime for queued tasks. Collecting a sample trace now.

Ben - infra: Collected sample traces and logs. Key snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:14:10Z] runtime: model-unavailable: no available allocation for model-quant-v2 in region southeast4
[2026-03-15T10:14:11Z] autoscaler: attempted-provision: 8 GPUs -> denied (quota)
```

Eve (SRE): I'm switching autoscaler policy to be more conservative to prevent continuous retries: `max_attempts=2`, `backoff=120s`. That should reduce noise and give us breathing room.

Alice (oncall): Running a spike test on fallback path to ensure correctness. I'll keep the on-call channel open for updates.

incidents-bot: Pager update: Queue length down 18% since CPU fallback and throttles. Autoscaler still reporting quotaExceeded errors. TICKET-99217 remains open.

Ben - infra: GCP support replied with initial triage: "Quota is consumed by another project in same org. We can either re-assign quotas or validate an urgent quota increase. Provide business justification and expected spike duration."

Eve (SRE): I'm preparing the justification: P1 incident impacting paid customers, ETA to clear backlog with current mitigations ~45min, request +50 GPUs for 1 hour. Sending now.

GCP Support Bot: Quota change request submitted. Reference QCR-7491. If approved, propagation may take 10-20 minutes.

Carol (prodeng): Can we proactively reduce model size by switching prod-generation to a lighter variant for non-enterprise keys? A/B toggle ready if infra gives the green light.

Ben - infra: Toggled non-enterprise traffic to model-quant-v1-lite in southeast4 and eu-west1. That frees up roughly 20% GPU capacity for priority traffic.

Dan - support: Customer update sent: now showing improvements; we've rerouted critical traffic and reduced load. No further escalations yet.

Alice (oncall): Keeping watch. If quota isn't increased we'll maintain cross-region routing and CPU fallbacks until backlog clears. Once GCP confirms quota bump, we'll scale back conservative policies and restore normal routing.

incidents-bot: Final update at 10:54Z: GCP approved temporary quota increase +50 GPUs for 2 hours (QCR-7491 approved). Autoscaler scaled additional nodes, queue draining accelerated. Incident moving to recovery monitoring.

Eve (SRE): Confirmed autoscaler success. Gradually reverting throttles and routing over 10 minutes to avoid a spike.

Carol (prodeng): Postmortem action items: 1) add quota headroom alerts (>=80% regional GPU use) 2) implement automatic cross-region failover for enterprise keys 3) add runbook step to reduce model size on-the-fly. Creating tasks.

Alice (oncall): Thanks team. I'll hand off to Eve for a detailed post-incident follow-up and to Dan for customer communications. 

Eve (SRE): Taking handoff. Will work with infra to file quota mitigation playbook + runbook updates.

Dan - support: Will follow up with customers with RCA once postmortem is ready.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-2307 status: Resolved -> monitoring. Duration: ~42 minutes.

Alice (oncall): Closing thread from oncall. Great coordination everyone. :heart:
